patch.summary: Grant a user's global role — admin only

400.description: `globalRole` is not one of `user`, `setter`, `admin` (`admin_role_invalid`), or the caller tried to remove their own admin role (`admin_self_demotion`)

403.description: Signed in, but not an admin (`admin_forbidden`), or authenticated by an access token rather than an interactive session (`session_required`) — this route is session-only, exactly like `/auth/tokens`

post.summary: Sign in and receive a session cookie

401.description: Invalid credentials or a TOTP code is required

post.description: The body is the raw tar+zstd archive bytes (see @duckoj/package-format). The `hash` query parameter is the hash the client claims for it; the server unpacks the archive, recomputes the hash from the file digests, and rejects the upload if it disagrees.

201.description: The package was verified and stored

413.description: The archive exceeds the server-configured upload size limit

422.description: The archive could not be unpacked, the claimed hash does not match its contents, the manifest is invalid, or two paths collide once case-folded or Unicode-normalised
The `hash` path parameter is not a valid package hash

403.description: Signed in, but not permitted to perform this action on this problem

409.description: That problem code is already taken

get.summary: A single problem visible to the caller

404.description: No such problem, or one the caller may not see — the two are indistinguishable

patch.summary: Update a problem's name, statement, visibility, sharing or membership

400.description: The patch carried `code` (immutable) or would leave the problem with no author

403.description: Signed in, but not permitted to perform this action on this problem

404.description: No such problem, or one the caller may not see — the two are indistinguishable

get.summary: A problem's revision history — draft, published and archived alike

404.description: No such problem, or the caller is not a member (any role) or admin — unlike GET /problems/{code}, public or org visibility alone is not enough to see revision history

post.summary: Attach an already-uploaded package as a new draft revision

201.description: The new draft revision was created

403.description: Signed in, but not permitted to perform this action on this problem

404.description: No such problem, or no such package

422.description: The package manifest is invalid, or its paths collide

post.summary: Publish a draft or archived revision, archiving whatever was previously published

403.description: Signed in, but not permitted to perform this action on this problem

404.description: No such problem, or no such revision version

201.description: The submission was accepted and queued

404.description: No such problem, or no such language

get.summary: A submission visible to the caller

404.description: No such submission, or one the caller may not see — the two are indistinguishable

422.description: The `id` path parameter is not a valid submission id
